question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH constructor_yearly_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
constructor_max_points AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, MAX(total_points) as max_points
    FROM constructor_yearly_points
    GROUP BY constructor_id
),
top_3_constructors AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, max_points
    FROM constructor_max_points
    ORDER BY max_points DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
top_3_with_years AS (
    SELECT c.name, cs.constructor_id, cs.max_points, yp.year
    FROM top_3_constructors cs
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    JOIN constructor_yearly_points yp ON cs.constructor_id = yp.constructor_id AND yp.total_points = cs.max_points
)
SELECT name, constructor_id, max_points, year
FROM top_3_with_years
ORDER BY max_points DESC, year

    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
) cs
JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
GROUP BY c.name, cs.constructor_id
ORDER BY max_points DESC

    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),

    SELECT constructor_id, MAX(total_points) as max_points
    FROM constructor_yearly_points
    GROUP BY constructor_id
),
top_3_constructors AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, max_points
    FROM constructor_max_points
    ORDER BY max_points DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
top_3_with_years AS (
    SELECT c.name, cs.constructor_id, cs.max_points, yp.year
    FROM top_3_constructors cs
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    JOIN constructor_yearly_points yp ON cs.constructor_id = yp.constructor_id AND yp.total_points = cs.max_points
)
SELECT name, constructor_id, max_points, year
FROM top_3_with_years
ORDER BY max_points DESC, year"}

),

    FROM constructor_yearly_points

),
top_3_constructors AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, max_points
    FROM constructor_max_points
    ORDER BY max_points DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
top_3_with_years AS (
    SELECT c.name, cs.constructor_id, cs.max_points, yp.year
    FROM top_3_constructors cs
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    JOIN constructor_yearly_points yp ON cs.constructor_id = yp.constructor_id AND yp.total_points = cs.max_points
)
SELECT name, constructor_id, max_points, year
FROM top_3_with_years
ORDER BY max_points DESC, year
